title: Quran Recitation Basics
description: Learn to recite the Quran properly with correct pronunciation using the classical Husary recitation method with repetition for practice.
short_description: Classical Husary recitation with practice repetition

modules.title: Opening Chapters of the Quran
modules.description: Begin your recitation journey with the short Surahs and Al-Fatihah, following Shaykh Husary's method.

lessons.title: Surah Al-Fatihah - Recitation Practice
lessons.content: Practice reciting Surah Al-Fatihah (سُورَةُ الفَاتِحَة) with Shaykh Mahmud Khalil al-Husary's beautiful tarteel recitation style.

lessons.title: Surah An-Nas to Surah Al-Asr
lessons.content: Recitation practice of the short Makki Surahs: An-Nas (سُورَةُ النَّاس), Al-Falaq (سُورَةُ الفَلَق), Al-Ikhlas (سُورَةُ الإِخْلَاص), and Al-Asr (سُورَةُ العَصْر).

lessons.title: Surah Al-Qadr to Surah Al-Bayyinah
lessons.content: Continuing practice with Surah Al-Qadr (سُورَةُ القَدْر), Surah Al-Humazah (سُورَةُ الهُمَزَة), and Surah Al-Bayyinah (سُورَةُ البَيِّنَة).

modules.title: Building Recitation Skills
modules.description: Progress to longer Surahs and develop fluency in Quranic recitation.

lessons.title: Surah Ad-Duha to Surah Al-Inshirah
lessons.content: Recitation practice of Surah Ad-Duha (سُورَةُ الضُّحَى), Surah Al-Inshirah (سُورَةُ الإِنْشِرَاح), and connecting verses for fluency.

lessons.title: Surah At-Tin to Surah Al-Qadr
lessons.content: Practice reciting Surah At-Tin (سُورَةُ التِّين), Surah Al-Alaq (سُورَةُ العَلَق), and building confidence in recitation.

lessons.title: Surah Al-Mulk to Surah Al-Insan
lessons.content: Recitation practice of longer Surahs including Surah Al-Mulk (سُورَةُ المُلْك) and Surah Al-Insan (سُورَةُ الإِنْسَان).
